conciseReport:
# TEST2-89 — interrupted QA attempt

Automobile MS Teams Call scope confirmed through its actual nested Test type and genuine /api/platform/automobile/ms-teams-call requests. Criterion 1 Passed; criterion 2 Blocked (selected-detail capture overwritten; member completeness also remains Unverified); criteria 3–14 Blocked by a stale execution host. No product failure is claimed.

The broad points load returned HTTP 200 with 239 aggregates. A genuine selected test, 132123874, loaded successfully; its saved detail image was later overwritten, so it is not acceptance proof. A normally applied one-minute scope returned 12 aggregates, but all underlying members were not reconciled. Before criterion 3, restored Automobile Call and original dates and preserved unrelated tabs.

During criterion 3, waiting failed with `code-mode host timed out waiting for wait response`, then `cell g10:35 belongs to a stale code-mode host generation`. Browser work stopped. The pending GIS/configuration operation's completion and final UI are unknown. No simulation handlers were installed. Browser lease retained intentionally for coordinator reconciliation; do not start another tester or assume restoration after this interruption.
reason: Attempt interrupted by stale execution host. Actual completed coverage retained. Browser lease deliberately preserved for coordinator reconciliation as required by the QA brief; no further browser actions or speculative cleanup performed.
cleanupRequired: Coordinator must reconcile the pending criterion-3 GIS/configuration operation, inspect current selections and restore owned changes if needed, then release this handoff's lease using its own recorded token. No request handlers were installed.
